nodes.summary: A group $G$ has $c$-dimension at most $k$ if every strictly decreasing chain $C_G(X_0) > C_G(X_1) > \cdots > C_G(X_m)$ of centralizers of subsets $X_0, \dots, X_m$ of $G$ has length $m \le k$.
nodes.title: Centralizer dimension at most $k$

nodes.title: Buturlakin's theorem on locally finite groups of finite $c$-dimension

nodes.summary: The statement that there is a function $f : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ such that for every $k \in \mathbb{N}$ and every locally finite group $G$ of $c$-dimension at most $k$ the following holds: if $R$ is a normal locally soluble subgroup of $G$ containing every normal locally soluble subgroup of $G$ (the locally soluble radical) and $S$ is the preimage in $G$ of the socle of $G/R$, then there is a subgroup $A$ of…
nodes.title: Vasil'ev's abelian section bound (Kourovka 19.101)

nodes.summary: A group $G$ is locally finite if every finitely generated subgroup of $G$ is finite.
nodes.title: Locally finite groups

nodes.summary: A subgroup $H$ of a group $G$ is locally soluble if every finitely generated subgroup of $H$ is soluble.
nodes.title: Locally soluble subgroups

nodes.summary: A subgroup $M$ of a group $Q$ is a minimal normal subgroup if $M$ is normal in $Q$, $M \ne \{1\}$, and every normal subgroup $N$ of $Q$ with $N \le M$ is either $\{1\}$ or $M$.
nodes.title: Minimal normal subgroups

nodes.summary: For a normal subgroup $R$ of a group $G$, the preimage in $G$ of the socle of $G/R$ under the quotient map $G \to G/R$.
nodes.title: Preimage of the socle of a quotient

nodes.summary: The socle of a group $Q$ is the subgroup of $Q$ generated by all minimal normal subgroups of $Q$; it is the trivial subgroup when $Q$ has no minimal normal subgroup.
nodes.title: Socle
